newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila mills plan to buy additional 35,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila mills plan to buy additional 35,000 T wheat.

text.p: Three more Philippine mills sought tenders on Wednesday for 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.
Earlier, traders said they received tender invitations for a total 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 7,500 tonnes of soybean following the overnight drop in U.S. prices.
Traders said bidding for the supply of 35,000 tonnes wheat, of which 29,750 tonnes is hard spring wheat and 5,250 tonnes is western white wheat, was set at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT).
Traders said bidding for the supply of 35,000 tonnes of wheat, of which 29,750 tonnes was for hard spring wheat and 5,250 tonnes for western white wheat, was set at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT).
